properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ring 0.16.20 supplies the TLS key agreement for rustls 0.20.9 (locked alongside it in the solana 1.16 client stack): X25519 ECDHE is negotiated in the HTTPS JSON-RPC sessions to the env-provided RPC_ENDPOINT (create_rpc_client helpers at src/common/utils.rs:24,36; live at src/main.rs:24). Harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure of RPC traffic. ring 0.16 (2021, unmaintained upstream) has no PQ/hybrid group support — migration needs rustls ≥0.23 with an X25519MLKEM768 provider. No direct app call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: rustls 0.20.9 is locked transitively as the solana 1.16 client stack's rustls-tls backend for reqwest (the HTTPS JSON-RPC sessions to RPC_ENDPOINT). TLS 1.3 capable but classical-only key agreement (X25519 via ring 0.16.20); rustls gained hybrid/PQ groups only in 0.23.x, so sessions it terminates are harvest-now-decrypt-later. App-level levers: upgrade the solana dependency chain or pin reqwest to the native-tls backend. No direct app call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ring 0.16.20 is the TLS crypto provider for rustls 0.20.9 in the solana client stack: X25519 ECDHE, AES-GCM, SHA-2, Ed25519/ECDSA verification for the RPC HTTPS sessions. 2021-era release, unmaintained upstream, no post-quantum support — the shipped binary carries these algorithms whether or not the app calls them directly; no direct call site found in application code (reached through the TLS stack).
